This misc. appeal by the appellant/claimant u/S. 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the Award dated 30.11.2015 passed by First Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Gwalior (M.P.) (in short "the Claims Tribunal") in Claim Case No.70/2013, on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.

sentences.text:
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in question.
3.

As per findings of the Claims Tribunal, in the case of injuries sustained by appellant/claimant in the motor accident, an amount of compensation to the tune of Rs.51,465/- has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal with interest from the date of filing of claim petition till its realization.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Claims Tribunal has awarded the compensation which is on lower side,
hence, it is prayed that compensation amount be enhanced and just and reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the appellant and perusal of the record as well as looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly, the injuries sustained by the claimant in the alleged accident, it would be appropriate to enhance to lump sum amount of Rs.40,000/-.
6. Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.
The amount of compensation is enhanced to lump sum amount of Rs.40,000/- in the present appeal.
The appellant/claimant is entitled to receive Rs.40,000/- in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal from the date of the filing of claim petition till its realization.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
Accordingly, the present appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *AVI*

6. Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.
